tasks.title: Unattended scheduler surface + host-side mutation rejection (B2+B4, decision 0106)
tasks.objective: Drop the six scheduler mutation tools from autonomous-lane surfaces in BOTH selection paths (permissionLane option; GANTRY_PERMISSION_LANE threaded into the runner parse path), widen PermissionRunRestriction with runKind/jobId/runId from isScheduledJob, host-reject mutations whose entry is scheduled or missing, stamp signed source provenance in writeIpcFile (add GANTRY_RUN_ID), and replace the scheduled prompt's self-edit instruction with the no-mutation control policy.
acceptance_criteria: a scheduled (autonomous-lane) spawn's tool surface lacks scheduler_update/upsert/pause/resume/run_now/delete in BOTH the projection and the runner-process parse path, keeps all read tools; interactive keeps both sets
scheduler mutate handlers reject requests whose host-side run-restriction entry is scheduled or missing (missing = untrusted); interactive mutations proceed under the ask policy; reads unaffected
writeIpcFile's signed requestContext carries sourceJobId/sourceRunId/sourceRunKind from host-injected env; forged-field tamper rejected
scheduled prompt states inspect-only control policy and proposedJobChange reporting; self-edit instruction removed
both sandbox spawn suites carry any new runner-reachable module
